Subject: Invoice submission for PO 78945 — portal vs email?

Hi Irene,

We are preparing the November invoice tied to Redwood PO 78945. Quick questions so we send things correctly and avoid rework:

- Do you require us to upload the invoice to the vendor portal, or is emailing invoices@redwood.com with a subject token acceptable?
- If email is ok as a fallback, what subject/file-name convention should we use so the system auto-ingests the PO?
- For multi-line orders, should each line be a separate CSV row or a single PDF with line items?
- How do you want VAT/tax lines represented (separate row vs inline)?

I attached a sample CSV and the PO PDF for reference (ACME_invoice_sample.csv, PO-78945.pdf). If there's a short mapping template you prefer, please send it and we'll match it.

Thanks — we want this to be plug-and-play to avoid payment delays.

Best,

Hi Carlos — thanks for sending the sample and the PO. Short answers and the recommended path below: 

1) Preferred channel: vendor portal (portal.redwood.com/invoices). We will provision an account for Acme so future uploads are automatic and traceable. Portal uploads guarantee immediate PO-linking and timestamping.

2) Email fallback: use invoices@redwood.com. Subject should contain the PO token exactly as: PO:78945. Filename convention we prefer for fallback is: redwood_PO78945_AcmeSupplies_YYYYMMDD.ext (e.g., redwood_PO78945_AcmeSupplies_20261101.pdf). This helps our ingest pipeline de-duplicate and surface receipts to finance.

3) Line items & VAT: For CSV/flat ingest, put each invoice line on its own row; include a separate row for tax with TaxType=VAT and TaxAmount filled. For PDF uploads, include a clear line-item table. If you're sending a mixed bundle (PDF + CSV), make sure the CSV has a column InvoiceRef that matches the PDF filename.

4) Multi-currency: portal supports multi-currency and will set the invoice currency field. For email fallback, include a header line Currency: USD (or EUR) in the CSV to avoid manual intervention.

Attached is a short PO mapping template (redwood_po-mapping-template.xlsx) and a one-page vendor onboarding checklist. We'll provision the portal account; Jordan, can you create the vendor login and send setup steps to Carlos?

Action items:
- Jordan: portal account + invite (create vendor id ACME-78945)
- Carlos: on next invoice use portal if possible; otherwise use email subject token PO:78945 and filename convention above

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_po-mapping-template.xlsx

Irene — thanks, very helpful. A couple of clarifying points before we onboard: 

- For the CSV tax row, do you need a TaxRate column or will TaxAmount be enough? Example row we're using now: 
  ACME_INV_001, PO78945, 2026-11-01, Widget A, 2, 150.00, 300.00, VAT, 20.00

- Timestamping: does the portal use the upload timestamp for recognition (we want to ensure the invoice is considered received on the invoice date field, not the upload date)? Also, if we email invoices@redwood.com, will the ingest record the received timestamp so we can confirm receipt in our ERP?

- Small ask: sometimes our accounting system exports filenames with special characters (commas, ampersands). Will the ingest strip or reject those, or should we ensure sanitized filenames?

Appreciate the quick answers so we can update our template before the monthly run.

Best,
Carlos

Carlos — answers inline and next steps: 

- Tax: include TaxRate where possible but TaxAmount is required. If you include both, perfect — we reconcile automatically. So add a TaxRate column (percentage) and TaxAmount. That CSV row you pasted looks fine; just add a TaxRate column between UnitPrice and TaxAmount (e.g., 20).

- Timestamping: portal uses the upload timestamp for our internal receipt log but we also ingest the invoice "InvoiceDate" field and surface both. For payment terms we use InvoiceDate for due-date calculation but the receipt timestamp is captured for audit. For email fallback, our ingestion records the email Received-Date in the header and produces an ingest receipt email back to the sender with a tracking id.

- Filenames: sanitize on your side (alphanumeric, underscore, dash). The pipeline will attempt safe-normalization but we prefer you avoid commas/ampersands to prevent edge cases. Use the filename convention I sent earlier.

- Portal account: Jordan will send the invite within the hour. Once you accept, please upload a dummy invoice so we can validate ingestion end-to-end and confirm the tracking id back to you.

Jordan — please create vendor ACME-78945 in the portal, enable multi-currency, and send the invite + a one-click accept link. Also add Stephanie on the onboarding so finance can confirm mapping.

Thanks — let me know when the invite is out and we will monitor the test upload.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
